label: Rich Text Editor
description: A WYSIWYG rich text editor node built on TipTap (MIT, vendored — fully offline, no CDN). Toolbar with bold, italic, headings H1–H3, bullet/ordered lists, links and undo/redo. Inputs: HTML (set content), Placeholder, Editable. Outputs: HTML, Text and a Changed signal on every edit. Toolbar and content chrome follow the app theme via design tokens.
